uat.doc.title: UAT coverage of acceptance criteria
uat.doc.generated: Generated by `npm run uat:trace` from the implementation plan and the titles of the tests; do not edit by hand. A criterion is covered when a live (not skipped) test title carries its id. A story with the status DONE, DONE_PENDING_ENV or DONE_UNCONFIRMED in `docs/story-status.json` fails the gate when one of its ids is not covered; a DONE_PENDING_ENV story may declare the ids that only an external system can prove (field externalChecks).
uat.doc.totals: Criteria named in a live test title: {covered} of {total} (named only in skipped tests: {skipped}; named nowhere: {missing}).

uat.EXTERNAL_NO_CHECK: docs/story-status.json declares an external check for {id} without saying what the external system has to prove
uat.doc.externalNote: Criteria that a DONE_PENDING_ENV story declares in the field externalChecks of docs/story-status.json: they need an external system (or the review of a document) and have no live test here.
